title: This is the email we send hotels 24 hours before check in and gets us free perks 90% of the time!
description:
This is the email we send hotels 24 hours before check in… and it gets us free perks almost 90% of the time.

Most families book a hotel…
Show up…
And hope for the best.

But after years of family travel, we realized something important.

Hotels plan your stay before you even arrive.

Room assignments.
Amenities.
Special notes.

And many of those decisions happen the day before check in.

So now we send one simple email about 24 hours before arrival.

Not demanding.
Not pushy.

Just warm, thoughtful, and intentional.

And honestly… the results have surprised us.

Over the years we’ve received things like:

✨ Complimentary room upgrades
✨ Kids welcome treats waiting in the room
✨ Free birthday cakes and treats
✨ Early check in or late check out
✨ Free breakfast or dining credits
✨ Special notes for the kids

All from one simple email.

Here’s what we include in the email:

1️⃣ A warm introduction
We mention we’re a traveling family with kids and how excited we are for the stay.

2️⃣ A personal detail
If it’s a birthday, first overseas trip, or something special for the kids, we share it.

3️⃣ A polite request
We ask if there are any available family friendly room options or upgrades.

4️⃣ Gratitude in advance
This part matters. Hotels appreciate kindness more than demands.

This is one of our favorite hotel hacks for family travel.

Because a thoughtful message can turn a normal hotel stay into a memorable experience for traveling with kids.

Interesting fact: Many hotels finalize room allocations about 24 hours before guest arrival, which is why this timing works so well.

A small email.

A big difference in your family vacation.

Save this for your next trip.
